numerologyClassic.footer: For personal awareness only · not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice
numerologyClassic.disclaimer: The numbers in this report were calculated with the selected classical numerology methods; the interpretations are traditional method interpretations and contain no definitive judgement, prediction or guarantee.
numerologyClassic.stoneDisclaimer: Stone suggestions are based on the symbolic and traditional interpretations of numerology; they are not a medical diagnosis, treatment or health advice and do not replace a professional assessment.
numerologyClassic.noMerge: The numbers of the two methods are not merged or reduced to a single result; each number must be read with its own method's formula.

coreMethod.lifePath: The month, day and year components of the date of birth are reduced separately, then added and reduced again. 11, 22 and 33 are kept as master numbers.
coreMethod.expression: The Pythagorean values of all letters of the full name (A=1 … I=9 cycle) are added and reduced separately for each name; intermediate totals of 13/14/16/19 are marked as karmic debt.
coreMethod.soulUrge: Only the Pythagorean values of the vowels are added and reduced.
coreMethod.personality: Only the Pythagorean values of the consonants are added and reduced.
coreMethod.birthDay: The day of birth (day of the month) is taken directly; two-digit days are reduced if necessary.
coreMethod.maturity: The Life Path and Expression numbers are added and reduced.

numerologyClassic.chaldeanMethod: In the Chaldean (Cheiro) method letters are given values 1–8 (9 is considered sacred and is not assigned to a letter). The total compound number (10–52) is read with its own meaning, then reduced to a single-digit root.

method.heading: Method Note
method.note: The report is produced only from the saved analysis; no new calculation is made when the report is generated. The numbers are also compared with an independent calculation and the result is shown next to each number as “Verification” (in the technical and full reports).
method.partial: Some techniques could not be calculated in this analysis. Missing sections have not been added to the report.
method.partialWith: Some techniques could not be calculated in this analysis: {list}. Missing sections have not been added to the report.

karmic.heading: Karmic Lessons and Karmic Debts
karmic.lessonsSub: Karmic lessons — distribution of numbers in the name (1–9)
karmic.none: No number is missing from the name; there is no karmic lesson.
karmic.noDebt: There is no karmic debt (13, 14, 16, 19) in the core numbers.

timing.heading: Timing — Pinnacles, Challenges and Personal Cycles
timing.dailyCommon: Common symbolic number for this day
timing.dailySeed: Symbolic number produced with a personal seed
timing.dailyNote: This number is not calculated from birth data and is not the Personal Day; it is the classical method's daily symbolic guide.

bridge.heading: Bridge Numbers
bridge.lead: A bridge number is the difference between two core numbers; it shows the quality to develop in order to reconcile the two energies.

hidden.heading: Hidden Passion and Subconscious Self
hidden.frequent: Most frequent number(s) in the name: {list} ({count} times)

maturity.heading: Maturity Status
maturity.note: The influence of the maturity number usually becomes clear in middle age and guides the second half of life.

chaldean.heading: Chaldean Name Analysis — {method}
chaldean.cautionNote: Caution mark: the classical method notes that this number's influence can be challenging when it is not lived in balance; this is not a definitive judgement.

dual.heading: Two-System Comparison
dual.lead: The same name is calculated with two separate methods. The results are shown side by side; they are not converted into each other or merged.
dual.same: Both methods give the same root number
dual.diff: The two methods give different numbers

lucky.heading: Lucky Associations
lucky.lead: Traditional associations derived from the ruling planet of the Life Path number in the classical method.

stones.heading: Numerology – Natural Stones
stones.s1lead: The list of lucky stones the classical method gives for the Life Path number.
stones.pairsFallback: Stones used together with the direct suggestions
stones.exact: Exact match (the stone's numerical vibration = your core number)
stones.root: Via the root number (single-digit root of a master / compound number — not an exact match)
stones.noRoot: No match via the root number.
stones.noPlanet: No stone associated with the ruling planet was found.
stones.noLibrary: The stone library could not be used in this report; only the names in the classical method list are shown.

person.noChart: This analysis has no full numerology chart; only the selected techniques are reported.

stonesReport.subtitle: Symbolic and traditional stone matching
stonesReport.noChart: The record has no numerology chart.

rel.scoreNote: Overall compatibility is a classical method score; its formula is not documented in the source, so it cannot be independently verified. The Life Path, Expression and Soul Urge numbers are also checked independently.
rel.verifyNote: Independent check of the numbers (excluding the score):
rel.none: This record has no compatibility result.

biz.name: Business name
biz.none: This record has no business name result.

names.heading: Candidates
names.lead: Each candidate is calculated separately with two methods; the results are shown side by side, are not merged and no ranking/score is produced.

missingSide.legacy: No Holistic Numerology record was found; only the classical side is shown.
missingSide.classic: No classical analysis result was found; only the Holistic Numerology side is shown.
missingSide.both: No comparable record was found for either side.

cmp.noValues: This method has no comparable value.
